findings.where: header, mobile menu button at 375px (x 335, y 22, 20x20)
findings.evidence: dom-375.json: the only visible header control besides 'Get started' is a <button> whose text and accessible name are both empty (an icon-only hamburger). The sweep's control_names did not flag it.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: screen-reader users hear only 'button' for the sole route to the mobile navigation.

findings.where: header nav: 'Find my stack', 'AI tools', 'Compare', 'About', 'Sign in'
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: all five nav items are <button> elements with href null inside <nav>; none is a link. They cannot be opened in a new tab and are announced as buttons, not navigation.
findings.after: AI tools… (real URLs for each destination)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: navigation exposed with the wrong role; if they do nothing, 2.4.4 Link Purpose also fails because the control has no destination.

findings.evidence: Focus crop shows the blue button with only a faint 1px light-grey auto outline at 50% alpha against the light page; on the #1d4ed8 fill the ring is nearly invisible. Confirms the sweep's 1.52:1 change ratio for buttons.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible (and 2.4.13 at AAA): keyboard users cannot see where they are.

findings.evidence: landmarks: main 1, nav 1, header 1, footer 0. No contentinfo; no ownership, contact or privacy links anywhere.
findings.after: <footer> with owner, contact and privacy links
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 3.2.6 Consistent Help (contact path) is not met.

findings.evidence: 375 tile 00/01: the 'Ready to go' status pill wraps to two lines and is clipped at the card edge ('Ready to / go').
findings.before: Pill in a flex row with the title, no shrink rule
findings.after: white-space: nowrap on the pill and flex-wrap on the row, or move the pill under the title at small widths
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: content clipped at narrow width.

strengths: lang='en' and a descriptive title are set; one h1 and a sensible h2/h3 outline.
Focus order (8 stops) follows the visual order left to right, top to bottom.
not_investigated: Live keyboard operation of the mobile menu (no Playwright run in this review)
Alt text: the page has no content images; tool tiles are text letters
Forms and errors: no forms on the captured page
Sweep Floor hits (INT-001 count, text sizes) checked against tile 00 and agree
